title: Stronger, better, and re-reoccurring
content: So I have been part of Mallworld sub for less time then other Dream related subs. However, I have noticed a strengthening as well as better lucidity of my dreams since joint this specific sub. I don't even go on subs for lucid dreaming anymore. I have even had old reoccurring dreams make a come back lately thanks to threads in this specific sub, ones I have totally have forgotten about until I dreamed them again. As I said I have very active dreamscape, but oddly I have had a lot more since participating in THIS SPECIFIC Sub. My dreams to be a lot stronger longer even mote detailed then normal. Yet my dreams have always been extremely realistic, vivid, and rather second life experiencing. So I never thought things can get deeper in terms of dreams. Out of curiosity does this Sub the MallWorld, have a posite impact on other people's dreams? Any improvements? Increased activity? Or changes on feelings regarding their dreams? I definitely feel like my dreams broke the fifth wall in a matter of depth and oddly kinda enlightening.
